protocol.projection: Habitat camera 256x256, HFOV 75 degrees, sensor height 1.10m; WXYZ rotation; camera forward is -Z
protocol.projected_area: in-FOV 17-joint bbox area/image area multiplied by front and in-FOV fractions
protocol.limb_projection: mean projected 2D limb length / GT 3D limb length over H36M17 edges and six frames
protocol.joint_separation: mean left/right wrist/elbow/knee/ankle separation normalized by projected body bbox diagonal
protocol.normalization: within-context legal-candidate min-max; equal weights only
protocol.terminal: selected real archived skeleton through frozen reduced12 ST-GCN
